question: 平均评分是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(rating), 1) AS avg_rating FROM reviews

question: 消费前三的城市是哪些？
gold_sql: SELECT city, ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) AS sales FROM orders GROUP BY city ORDER BY sales DESC LIMIT 3

question: 有多少顾客浏览未下单？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS browse_only FROM events

question: 每月销售额是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT month, SUM(sales) FROM t GROUP BY month
